paragraphs: Sentinel Offender Services supplies the monitoring hardware, software and staffing that community corrections programs run on. The company argues those three pieces work best together and builds its products to reinforce one another.

Location tracking runs on a one-piece device using GPS, WiFi and cellular positioning to follow a participant around the community. A radio frequency home monitoring product is sold on its simple, durable design for community corrections agencies. Domestic violence monitoring follows both the participant and the victim so locations can be compared and the victim alerted. Analytics software sorts the flow of alerts by picking out events an officer actually needs to act on. On the services side, staff handle monitoring administration and participant fee collection so officers can stay on supervision. Text messages and automated calls remind participants about court dates and required appointments.

Alerts are watched from a monitoring center the company owns and operates itself. It says it has provided this continuum of services for more than 25 years. Its mobile applications are aimed at agencies handling low-risk supervision and victim notification. The site lists an ISO 9001:2015 certification. It also lists itself as a NASPO ValuePoint supplier. A counter on the page tallies participants who have finished its programs since 1993.

quote.text: Effective participant monitoring requires reliable hardware, intelligent software and continuous professional support.
